text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — I opened a tiny PR to clarify how batching + KV prefetch behave for short sequences (<64). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/341 The current wording implies prefetch always wins but that's not true for very small requests (batch_size 1-2).
Marco: Nice, can you paste the actual snippet change here so I can do a quick read?
Anya: Snippet (inline): `client.generate(model='gpt-small', max_tokens=32, batch_size=2, prefetch_kv=True)` and the new sentence I propose: "prefetch helps when repeated prefixes are common across requests; for tiny single-shot requests the setup cost can outweigh the benefit."
Priya: Looks good. Also add a short note about quant profiles — 4-bit quantization can change perf characteristics here; maybe recommend `quant_profile: balanced` for short seqs.
Rohan: Can we include a micro-benchmark row so readers have a ballpark? I can run a quick check and paste numbers.
docs-bot: Automated link check: PR URL reachable, no broken links detected. (checks: 1/1)
Anya: Thanks — @Rohan if you drop numbers I'll fold them into a tiny table. @Marco please check wording for 'always' -> 'typically' or 'may'.
Marco: LGTM on wording. Minor nit: wrap `prefetch_kv` and `quant_profile` in backticks. Also suggest one-sentence example for when prefetch is a win (duplicate prompt prefix across users).
Priya: Also consider adding an SDK snippet for Node (many examples current are Python). We should keep Go as a TODO.
Anya: Adding Node snippet now, will mark Go TODO. Node snippet: `await client.responses.create({ model: 'gpt-small', input: prompt, max_tokens: 32, batching: { batch_size: 2 }, prefetch_kv: true })`
Rohan: Quick bench I ran on devbox (nv4): `seq=32,batch=1: 12ms median; batch=4: 9ms median; enabling prefetch_kv adds ~+2ms for batch=1, but saves ~3ms at batch=4 when prefixes align` — posting raw numbers so you can choose how to present them.
Anya: Added a 3-row micro-bench table and a one-paragraph explanation of tradeoffs. Will merge in ~30m unless any objections.
Marco: No objections from me. added `small-pr` label.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Anya: Merged and pushed. I'll follow up with a short blurb for the next release notes and ping docs-subscribers. Thanks all!
